commit.message:
Urgent attribution fix (#149)

In the hurry and excitement of the last two days, it seems the blog post
about the Riemannan hypothesis has been mistakenly attributed to “the
Lean and Mathlib communities”. Clearly such an attribution would at
least require a discussion among Mathlib maintainers and reviewers on
the Mathlib side. Pending such a discussion, I propose a more factual
attribution (assuming the actual authors of that post wish to remain
anonymous).

commit.message:
ci: declare GITHUB_TOKEN permissions on jobs that write (#141)

This PR declares the permissions the job needs on its `GITHUB_TOKEN`, so
that it keeps working when the organization default for workflow tokens
becomes read-only.
